// DASH-005 — Logon Duration Summary
// Source intent: D005-SPL-028 / reference SPL-00589
let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
Logon_LogonDetail
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend NormalizedUser=tolower(User), EffectiveSessionKey=iff(isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),tostring(SessionGUID),strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID)))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or NormalizedUser =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or EffectiveSessionKey == SessionFilter
| where isnotnull(TotalLogonTimeMs)
| summarize
    LogonEvents = count(),
    AvgTotalLogonTimeMs = avg(toreal(TotalLogonTimeMs)),
    AvgProfileLoadTimeMs = avg(toreal(ProfileLoadTimeMs)),
    AvgGroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs = avg(toreal(GroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs)),
    AvgADLogonScriptTimeMs = avg(toreal(ADLogonScriptTimeMs)),
    AvgGroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs = avg(toreal(GroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs)),
    AvgShellStartupTimeMs = avg(toreal(ShellStartupTimeMs))
| project
    LogonEvents,
    AvgLogonSeconds = round(AvgTotalLogonTimeMs / 1000.0, 2),
    AvgProfileLoadSeconds = round(AvgProfileLoadTimeMs / 1000.0, 2),
    AvgGroupPolicySeconds = round(AvgGroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs / 1000.0, 2),
    AvgADLogonScriptSeconds = round(AvgADLogonScriptTimeMs / 1000.0, 2),
    AvgGPLogonScriptSeconds = round(AvgGroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs / 1000.0, 2),
    AvgShellStartupSeconds = round(AvgShellStartupTimeMs / 1000.0, 2)

// DASH-005 — Logon Components Over Time
// Source intent: D005-SPL-029 / reference SPL-00590
let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let TimeBin = 1h;
Logon_LogonDetail
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend NormalizedUser=tolower(User), EffectiveSessionKey=iff(isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),tostring(SessionGUID),strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID)))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or NormalizedUser =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or EffectiveSessionKey == SessionFilter
| where isnotempty(SessionLogonTime)
| summarize
    EventCount = count(),
    SumTotalLogonTimeMs = sum(TotalLogonTimeMs),
    SumProfileLoadTimeMs = sum(ProfileLoadTimeMs),
    SumGroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs = sum(GroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs),
    SumADLogonScriptTimeMs = sum(ADLogonScriptTimeMs),
    SumGroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs = sum(GroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs),
    SumShellStartupTimeMs = sum(ShellStartupTimeMs)
    by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin)
| extend RawOtherMs =
    SumTotalLogonTimeMs
    - SumProfileLoadTimeMs
    - SumGroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs
    - SumADLogonScriptTimeMs
    - SumGroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs
    - SumShellStartupTimeMs
| extend SumOtherMs = iff(RawOtherMs > 0, RawOtherMs, 0)
| extend
    OtherSeconds = iff(EventCount > 0, round(toreal(SumOtherMs) / EventCount / 1000.0, 2), real(null)),
    ShellStartupSeconds = iff(EventCount > 0, round(toreal(SumShellStartupTimeMs) / EventCount / 1000.0, 2), real(null)),
    GPLogonScriptSeconds = iff(EventCount > 0, round(toreal(SumGroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs) / EventCount / 1000.0, 2), real(null)),
    ADLogonScriptSeconds = iff(EventCount > 0, round(toreal(SumADLogonScriptTimeMs) / EventCount / 1000.0, 2), real(null)),
    GroupPolicyProcessingSeconds = iff(EventCount > 0, round(toreal(SumGroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs) / EventCount / 1000.0, 2), real(null)),
    ProfileLoadingSeconds = iff(EventCount > 0, round(toreal(SumProfileLoadTimeMs) / EventCount / 1000.0, 2), real(null))
| project
    TimeBucket,
    OtherSeconds,
    ShellStartupSeconds,
    GPLogonScriptSeconds,
    ADLogonScriptSeconds,
    GroupPolicyProcessingSeconds,
    ProfileLoadingSeconds
| order by TimeBucket asc

// DASH-005 — Logon Details by Session
// Source intent: D005-SPL-032 / reference SPL-00593
let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
Logon_LogonDetail
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend NormalizedUser=tolower(User), EffectiveSessionKey=iff(isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),tostring(SessionGUID),strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID)))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or NormalizedUser =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or EffectiveSessionKey == SessionFilter
| where isnotempty(SessionLogonTime)
| summarize
    arg_max(Timestamp, User, Host, SessionLogonTime),
    TotalLogonTimeMs = sum(TotalLogonTimeMs),
    ProfileLoadTimeMs = sum(ProfileLoadTimeMs),
    GroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs = sum(GroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs),
    ADLogonScriptTimeMs = sum(ADLogonScriptTimeMs),
    GroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs = sum(GroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs),
    ShellStartupTimeMs = sum(ShellStartupTimeMs)
    by SessionGUID
| project
    SessionGUID,
    User,
    Host,
    LogonTime = SessionLogonTime,
    TotalDurationSeconds = round(toreal(TotalLogonTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2),
    ProfileLoadingSeconds = round(toreal(ProfileLoadTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2),
    GroupPolicySeconds = round(toreal(GroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2),
    ADLogonScriptSeconds = round(toreal(ADLogonScriptTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2),
    GPLogonScriptSeconds = round(toreal(GroupPolicyLogonScriptTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2),
    ShellStartupSeconds = round(toreal(ShellStartupTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2),
    LastSeen = Timestamp
| order by LastSeen desc

// DASH-005 — Group Policy Logon Details by Session
// Source intent: D005-SPL-027 / reference SPL-00584
let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let LogonSessions =
    Logon_LogonDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend NormalizedUser=tolower(User), EffectiveSessionKey=iff(isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),tostring(SessionGUID),strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID)))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or NormalizedUser =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or EffectiveSessionKey == SessionFilter
    | where isnotempty(SessionLogonTime)
    | summarize
        arg_max(Timestamp, User, Host, SessionLogonTime),
        GroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs = sum(GroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs),
        DcDiscoveryTimeMs = sum(DcDiscoveryTimeMs)
        by SessionGUID;
let CseDetails =
    Logon_GroupPolicyCSEDetail2
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend NormalizedUser=tolower(User), EffectiveSessionKey=iff(isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),tostring(SessionGUID),strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID)))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or NormalizedUser =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or EffectiveSessionKey == SessionFilter
    | summarize CseDurationSeconds = round(avg(CseDurationS), 2)
        by SessionGUID, CseName;
LogonSessions
| join kind=leftouter CseDetails on SessionGUID
| project
    SessionGUID,
    User,
    Host,
    LogonTime = SessionLogonTime,
    TotalPolicyDurationSeconds = round(toreal(GroupPolicyTotalProcessingTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2),
    DcDiscoverySeconds = round(toreal(DcDiscoveryTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2),
    CseName,
    CseDurationSeconds,
    LastSeen = Timestamp
| order by LastSeen desc, CseName asc

// DASH-005 — Session Concurrency by Host
// Source intent: D005-SPL-064 / simplified reference SPL-00631
let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let PerMinute =
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where SessionID > 0
    | extend User=tolower(SessionUser), SessionKey=iff(isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),tostring(SessionGUID),strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID)))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or SessionKey == SessionFilter
| where isnotempty(User) and User != "sys"
    | summarize ConcurrentSessions = dcount(SessionGUID)
        by MinuteBucket = bin(Timestamp, 1m), Host;
PerMinute
| summarize
    arg_max(MinuteBucket, ConcurrentSessions),
    MinSessions = min(ConcurrentSessions),
    MaxSessions = max(ConcurrentSessions)
    by Host
| project
    Host,
    MinSessions,
    MaxSessions,
    LastSessions = ConcurrentSessions,
    LastSeen = MinuteBucket
| order by MaxSessions desc, Host asc

// DASH-005 — Session Lifecycle Details
// Source intent: D005-SPL-072 / simplified reference SPL-00639.
// Performance fields intentionally removed to avoid overlap with UESP and Machine Health.
let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let Sessions =
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | where SessionID > 0
    | extend User=tolower(SessionUser), SessionKey=iff(isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),tostring(SessionGUID),strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID)))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or SessionKey == SessionFilter
| where isnotempty(User) and User != "sys"
    | summarize
        arg_max(
            Timestamp,
            User,
            Host,
            SessionID,
            SessionProtocol,
            SessionConnectionState,
            SessionLogonTime
        )
        by SessionGUID
    | project
        SessionGUID,
        User,
        Host,
        SessionID,
        Protocol = SessionProtocol,
        ConnectionState = SessionConnectionState,
        SessionLogonTime,
        LastSeen = Timestamp;
let Logoff =
    Logoff_LogoffDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend NormalizedUser=tolower(User), EffectiveSessionKey=iff(isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),tostring(SessionGUID),strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID)))
| where isempty(UserFilter) or NormalizedUser =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or EffectiveSessionKey == SessionFilter
    | summarize
        arg_max(
            Timestamp,
            SessionEndTime,
            TotalLogoffTimeMs,
            SessionDurationMs
        )
        by SessionGUID
    | project
        SessionGUID,
        SessionEndTime,
        TotalLogoffTimeMs,
        SessionDurationMs;
Sessions
| join kind=leftouter Logoff on SessionGUID
| extend
    LogonDateTime = todatetime(SessionLogonTime),
    EndDateTime = todatetime(SessionEndTime)
| extend
    LifecycleState = iff(isnotnull(EndDateTime), "Ended", iff(isempty(ConnectionState), "Unknown", ConnectionState)),
    ObservedDurationHours = iff(
        isnull(LogonDateTime),
        real(null),
        iff(
            isnotnull(EndDateTime),
            round((EndDateTime - LogonDateTime) / 1h, 2),
            round((LastSeen - LogonDateTime) / 1h, 2)
        )
    ),
    ReportedDurationHours = iff(
        isnull(SessionDurationMs),
        real(null),
        round(toreal(SessionDurationMs) / 3600000.0, 2)
    ),
    LogoffDurationSeconds = iff(
        isnull(TotalLogoffTimeMs),
        real(null),
        round(toreal(TotalLogoffTimeMs) / 1000.0, 2)
    )
| project
    SessionGUID,
    User,
    Host,
    SessionID,
    Protocol,
    ConnectionState,
    LifecycleState,
    LogonTime = LogonDateTime,
    LastSeen,
    SessionEnd = EndDateTime,
    ObservedDurationHours,
    ReportedDurationHours,
    LogoffDurationSeconds
| order by LastSeen desc
